I posted the answer in #inc-vtg-hartford, in your thread.

- **First report:** your 10:42 AM post on 3 Aug, "gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant." The ticket SUP-5380 update log has an earlier entry at 08:12 ("Rebot failed; drivers queueing"), but the page doesn't say who wrote it. Check that before the postmortem treats 08:12 as the first report.
- **The guard:** at 10:42 the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. At 11:03 Mateo reported kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. The channel says nothing else about the guard between those times, so the gate log or the guard would have to fill that in.
